        .section .wx,"awx",@progbits
        .globl  badwx_data
        .type   badwx_data,@object
badwx_data:
        .byte   0x90
        .size   badwx_data, 1
        .text
        .globl  badwx_fn
        .type   badwx_fn,@function
badwx_fn:
        movl    $1, %eax
        ret
        .size   badwx_fn, .-badwx_fn
        .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
